一致する（Donor 側は 12,000 件と一致しない）: They match (the Donor side, 12,000, does not)

どちらとも一致しない（多対多なので件数の代用にできない）: Matches neither (many-to-many, so counts cannot serve as a proxy)
many-to-one の 9 件は、エッジ数が Origin 側のインスタンス: For the 9 many-to-one relationships the edge count matches the Origin instance count. For the 5 one-to-many relationships the edge count matches the Target instance count. The only many-to-many relationship is SupplierProvidesGift, and it matches neither. 9 + 5 + 1 = 15. If a count does not match, Origin and Target are swapped or the mapping table is wrong. The declarations themselves are registered as 15 / 15 in Chapter 15.
one-to-many を「Origin 側に必ず 1 本以上ある」と読まないで: Do not read one-to-many as "the Origin side always has at least one edge". In 2 of the 5, the real data contains Origin instances with no edge at all: there are 12,000 Donors, but 18 of them made no donation, and 10 Municipalities received none. Those two are therefore declared zero-to-many from ... rather than one-to-many. The remaining 3 are written one-to-many from ... because every Origin instance does carry at least one edge. Multiplicity (one-to-many or many-to-many) and optionality (whether zero edges are possible) are two separate questions, and both are decided from the real data.
